svg.title: tl-oracle is an independent evaluator
svg.desc: A formula and a lasso trace go to two independent evaluators. tl-mltl, the production evaluator, returns a verdict. tl-oracle converts the formula to its own tree of 17 node kinds, enumerates the completions of missing and conflicting evidence (at most 65,536 by default), filters them by fairness, and returns an Outcome or one of its 14 OracleError refusals. A differential test in tl-mltl compares the two results and reports whether they agree.
